_note: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. The schema deliberately mirrors real marine protected area layers (Natura 2000 marine / WDPA) and officially published seasonal closures, so that swapping in real data only requires reimplementing src/data.py.

config._threshold_note: Legal basis: Article 10(1), Council Regulation (EC) No 1224/2009 — a fishing vessel exceeding 15 m length overall must be fitted with and maintain in operation an AIS. Applicable to all EU-flagged fishing vessels since 31 May 2014. This is the single most important number in the system: it decides who is never flagged. Set per jurisdiction.
config.lawful_dark_derogation: Article 10, Regulation (EC) No 1224/2009 (as revised): the master of a Union fishing vessel may switch off the AIS in exceptional circumstances where the safety or security of the crew is imminently at risk. A dark vessel may therefore be lawfully dark. Surfaced in every brief as a standing caveat.
